items.why: Barron's says AMD shows the market has stopped making sense after Huang's dramatic return to Nvidia, with the swings hitting chip stocks hard.
Tech stocks are partly reversing the Nvidia-sparked rally, and Nvidia itself is giving back part of Monday's surge.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq-heavy index is falling as tech leads the market slide and partly reverses the Nvidia-sparked rally.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 1.88% while the Dow future is up 0.45%, and the VIX is up 3.3%.
summary: Stocks are lower Tuesday morning, with tech leading the slide as the Nvidia-sparked rally partly reverses. AMD and Nvidia are the biggest movers, and Bitcoin is also down sharply.
